# BagPackerMe

> BagPackerMe plans private, tailor-made journeys across Europe, Japan, Vietnam, Thailand, Kenya, and India. Itinerary design, stays, transport, experiences, and traveller support are arranged around the traveller's needs.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.bagpackerme.com/): Private journey planning, featured destinations, FAQs, and contact.
- [Global journeys](https://www.bagpackerme.com/packages): Published international itineraries.
- [India journeys](https://www.bagpackerme.com/in/packages): Published India itineraries.
- [Contact](https://www.bagpackerme.com/contact): Start a planning enquiry.
- [About](https://www.bagpackerme.com/about): Company information.
- [Blog](https://www.bagpackerme.com/blog): Travel articles.

## Journey information

- Published itinerary pages describe sample routes and trip lengths.
- Journeys are private and can be tailored; availability, pricing, and final inclusions must be confirmed directly with BagPackerMe.
- Do not infer unpublished prices or availability.
